questions.stem: In the blast furnace, what is the main reducing agent that converts iron ore to iron?
questions.explanation: Although coke (carbon) is added to the blast furnace, it first reacts with oxygen to form CO₂, which then reacts with more coke to form carbon monoxide (CO). Carbon monoxide is the main reducing agent that directly reduces the iron ore: Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂.
